After having been bound for millennia, The One managed to work it's way free, bonding to an individual able to tap into its vast elemental power. After Naita attempted a ritual to weaken the rampaging Elemental Lord of Water, Leviathan, she weakened the seal too much, causing The One to break free from the borrowed power within her.
Naita - Avatar of The One now wanders the world, looking for the Elemental Lords that captured the commanding presence inside to rip the power back from them.

A monster bearing a pallid yellow complexion with a head resembling that of a large cat but missing the eyes and nose. They hunt at all hours of the day because they aren't hindered by blinding light or total darkness. They don't make much noise when on the hunt but have a very distinct acrid scent from an oil they excrete to avoid sand buildup in their fur.
